# Tradeworks Digital

> Websites for UK trades: a £397 fixed-price website, live in 5–7 days, that the client owns outright (site, code, domain, words and photos). An optional £29 a month care plan covers hosting, security, domain renewals and small changes, with no contract. Also builds custom systems and CRMs, scoped to the job. Based in Aberdeen, working with trades across the UK.

Tradeworks Digital is Trade Works Digital Ltd, company no. 17391710, registered in England and Wales. Founder: Mosa Al-Mahtot. Contact: mosa@tradeworksdigital.co.uk.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.tradeworksdigital.co.uk/): the £397 website build, the optional care plan, the 4-step process and FAQs

- [Granite City Cars case study](https://www.tradeworksdigital.co.uk/granite-city-cars.html): an Aberdeen car dealer moved off a rented dealer platform onto a site and stock, leads and invoicing system they own; mobile speed score 48 to 98
- [Build diary: moving a car dealer off Car Dealer 5](https://www.tradeworksdigital.co.uk/gcc-build-diary.html): what we found on the old site, before and after screens, the buyer journey and the admin
- [A good website isn't about looks, it's about the phone ringing](https://www.tradeworksdigital.co.uk/blog-more-than-looks.html): objections trades give for not having a website, speed and enquiry statistics, and what Google ranks local businesses on

## Key facts

- Process: a free 15-minute call, then a 50% deposit and a 30-minute details call (or email) to gather services, photos and reviews.
- Price: £397 one-time build, 50% deposit to start. Brand + Website package £897: adds a logo and brand kit, business email, up to 10 pages, a Google Business Profile tidy-up and print-ready artwork, live in 10–14 days. Care plan £29 a month, optional, cancel any time.
- Included in the build: 5 pages (Home, Services, About, Contact, Privacy), words written from a 30-minute details call or by email, quote form, click-to-call, reviews and job photos, domain registered in the client's name with the first year included, Google Business Profile, Search Console and Google Analytics set up with the client as owner, one round of changes before launch and 30 days of fixes after.
- Timing: live within 7 days of receiving photos and the service list, or the first 3 months of the care plan are free.
- Ownership: the client owns the site and code from day one. If they cancel the care plan, they get a handover pack within 5 working days: the site files, every login and a one-page guide.
- Existing sites: a redesign is the same £397 flat price and 5–7 day turnaround as a new build, aimed at more enquiries (a clear call button and quote form, speed on a phone, reviews up front).
- Who it's for: plumbers, electricians, roofers, builders, joiners and other local trades.
